overview.alt: An illustrated twilight harbor between warm Hong Kong neighborhoods and Shenzhen's modern tree-lined waterfront.
overview.mobilePresentation: Prefer full-width panorama; central cover cropping loses the two shores.

hongKong.alt: A warmly lit Hong Kong noodle shop with street tables beneath apartment balconies, opening onto the harbor at sunset.

shenzhen.alt: A Shenzhen dining terrace beside a leafy pedestrian avenue, with illuminated glass towers and a transit entrance at twilight.
